user_data_coverage.detail: Excellent coverage of all Meta EMQ parameters (em, ph, fn, ln, ct, st, zp, country, external_id, fbc, fbp). Smart fallback chain from multiple sources (customer, billing, shipping). Anonymous ID generation for unauthenticated users. Only missing client_user_agent in view-content.js.

event_id_dedup.detail: Perfect deterministic event_id strategy. Shared formats between Custom Pixel and webhooks: ic_{checkout_token} for InitiateCheckout, purchase_{checkout_token} for Purchase. Proper dedup guards with Redis storage and 48h TTL.

hashing.detail: Correct SHA256 implementation with proper normalization. Phone numbers normalized to E.164 format with country code handling. Text fields properly sanitized (lowercase, diacritics removed). Minor: could add more robust international phone validation.

custom_data.detail: Good custom_data structure with content_ids, content_type, value, currency, num_items. Contents array with quantities and prices. Minor inconsistencies in content_type selection (product vs product_group) and some optional fields could be more consistently populated.

action_source.detail: Always correctly set to 'website' in buildEvent function across all event types.

event_time.detail: Correctly using Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) for Unix timestamp in seconds, not milliseconds.

recovery.detail: Sophisticated retry system with QStash scheduling, proper state machine, exponential backoff logic, and max retry limits. Recovery queue prevents duplicate retries. Only minor issue: could add jitter to prevent thundering herd.

pii_safety.detail: Good PII protection - only logs boolean flags for data presence, not raw values. Event IDs truncated in logs. Minor: some customer identifiers could be further obfuscated in diagnostics.

test_event_code.detail: Properly implemented in meta-capi.js - adds test_event_code to payload when META_TEST_EVENT_CODE env var is present.

error_handling.detail: Webhooks correctly return 200 status even on internal errors to prevent Shopify retries. Good error logging without exposing sensitive data. Minor: some endpoints could benefit from more granular error categorization.

critical_issues.issue: ViewContent endpoint doesn't extract client_user_agent from request headers, reducing match quality compared to other endpoints
critical_issues.fix: Add clientUserAgent extraction similar to other endpoints: const clientUserAgent = req.headers && req.headers['user-agent'];

critical_issues.issue: Phone normalization assumes NL (31) as default country code, which may not be appropriate for all markets
critical_issues.fix: Make default country code configurable via environment variable or detect from order/customer data

warnings.issue: CORS set to '*' for Custom Pixel compatibility
warnings.recommendation: Consider restricting to specific Shopify domains once Custom Pixel origin patterns are confirmed

warnings.issue: Browser script truncated in audit - unable to verify complete implementation
warnings.recommendation: Ensure browser bridge properly handles all edge cases for fbclid persistence and cart attribute sync

warnings.issue: Complex body reconstruction logic for webhook verification
warnings.recommendation: Monitor for edge cases in Vercel's request handling that might break HMAC verification

strengths: Comprehensive user data collection from multiple fallback sources
Sophisticated event state management with proper retry logic
Deterministic event_id strategy enabling perfect deduplication
Proper Meta CAPI parameter formatting and hashing
Robust webhook verification and error handling
top_3_improvements: Add client_user_agent to ViewContent endpoint to match other events
Make default country code configurable instead of hardcoding NL
Add more comprehensive phone number validation for international formats
